name: f1-racer-tooling
description: Dev-only tooling for the F1 Racer static site, plus the opt-in multiplayer room server (#36, part of #1). The game itself ships with zero build step and loads three.js from a CDN (see index.html/race.html/garage.html); this package.json exists so Node-side scripts under tools/ can import the exact same three.js version for circuit geometry checks, and so server/room-server.mjs can use the ws package. Nothing here is bundled into the shipped static site — the room server is a separate opt-in process a room-enabled session connects to over WebSocket, not something race.html/garage.html load.
